hypothesis: A peacetime modernization technology should not be prioritized for a resource-dependent successor when that resource is already revealed and the player has neither a stockpile, positive observed income nor an owned deposit that can be connected. Preserve researching the technology that reveals an unknown resource, preserve imported stockpiles/income and unimproved owned deposits, and leave wartime modernization unchanged. Retain the existing three-body cohort, full prerequisite cost ranking and Writing/two-city foundation gates; introduce no numeric research or war threshold.
